szoveg_eredeti:
Coming to ElevenLabs Summit NYC? So are the CEO of Customers Bank , Nasdaq 's head of AI, and the head of CX at Inter .

On November 11, our CFO Ethan Tandowsky is moderating a panel with:
- Sam Sidhu , President and CEO of Customers Bank, who grew it into a $25 billion franchise with a Net Promoter Score nearly double the banking average.
- Douglas Hamilton , an AI research and engineering leader at Nasdaq, whose team built the first AI-powered strike listing system and an SEC-approved order type.
 Daniela Mineiro , who leads customer experience at Inter, the Brazilian digital bank.

They join Jensen Huang of NVIDIA and Eric Glyman of Ramp on the lineup in New York City.
